items.question: What claim about the scope of suffering must hold if torment is said to occur across eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams?
premises: A fixed count of womb-diagrams is specified here.
Torment is attributed to beings in those locations.
The numerical scope limits the field of afflicted beings.
items.inference: Beings are tormented within the specified set of eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The exact nature of the womb-diagrams remains unspecified.
items.plain_english: In eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, beings are tormented.
